Core Topics Discussed | Topic | What Was Said (summarised) | Key Take‑aways | |-------|----------------------------|---------------| | **Sensitive‑data handling** | – Need to **tokenise** any PII (names, contacts, images) before it leaves the system.
– Tokens must be reversible for authorised users.
– Real‑time tokenisation was mentioned (e.g., “Michanel Hanan tokenisation”). | • Adopt a token‑based masking layer for all outbound data.
• Store mapping securely; expose only to authorised roles. | | **Knowledge‑base & Architecture docs** | – Updated KB will include the tokenisation design, processing flow, and “reduction” logic.
– A “processing guide” is being drafted but the attachment is still missing. | • Documentation must be versioned and shared (see Action 1). | | **UI/UX & ADLC design** | – Discussion of **ADLC (Application Development Life‑Cycle) controls**, UI mock‑ups, screenshots, and acceptance criteria.
– Need to capture UI screenshots in HTML/URL format for user‑story artefacts.
– References to a “composer” component and Chrome‑extension support. | • UI artefacts will be stored in a shared repo; acceptance criteria must be explicit. | | **Repository & Collaboration** | – Proposal to create a **GitHub (or similar) repository** for all pod artefacts (designs, docs, code).
– “Local branch” work and “model‑local” builds were mentioned. | • Centralised repo is a priority; set up within the next 48 h. | | **Sprint‑level tasks & deadlines** | – Several “next‑week” references (e.g., “ext week”, “by next stand‑up”).
– Need to finalise user‑story descriptions, acceptance criteria, and UI screenshots before the next review. | • Immediate focus on delivering the items listed under **Action Items**. | | **Blockers / Open questions** | – Missing attachment for the processing guide.
– Unclear which UI control library (“composer”) will be used.
– Need clarification on “Loria Hagar” and some ambiguous terminology. | • These will be clarified in follow‑up discussions. | --- ## 3. Invite all pod members. | Hager (PER 23) | **+2 days (by 26 Sep)** | Add README with contribution guidelines. | | 3 | **Prepare UI screenshots** for the current user stories (HTML/URL format) and upload to `ui-mocks/`. | Sayed (PER 5) | **Next stand‑up (27 Sep)** | Ensure each screenshot is linked in the corresponding story. | | 4 | **Finalize acceptance criteria** for all open user stories and add them to the backlog items. | Rif Kamal (PER 13) & Sayed (PER 5) | **27 Sep** | Review with Hager for UI consistency. | | 5 | **Integrate the tokenisation module** into the build pipeline; run a real‑time masking test on a sample data set. | Rif Kamal (PER 13) | **02 Oct (next sprint review)** | Coordinate with ehal Magdy for test data. | | 6 | **Review and clean the stakeholder contact list** to ensure no PII is exposed in shared documents. | PER 9 | **Immediate** | Flag any remaining PII for removal. | | 7 | **Complete the missing “processing guide” attachment** and verify it is accessible from the KB. | PER 1 | **24 Sep (after KB update)** | Notify the pod when available. | | 8 | **Clarify the UI control library (“composer”)** to be used and confirm compatibility with the Chrome extension. | Hager (PER 23) & ehal Magdy (PER 2) | **By 28 Sep** | Schedule a short sync if needed. | --- ## 5.
